title: Fog with a spectrum

techniques.name: Soft-focus field

blur.label: Focus blur
blur.note: Every blur the plate lays, as a multiple of its own: the fog is painted small and blown up through it. Below 0.8 the spectrum ribbons show their square ends.

fogtop.label: Fog line
fogtop.note: Where the fog starts, against the page’s own (halfway down): negative raises it.

fogd.label: Fog density
fogd.note: Opacity of the fog wash at its line (the page’s 0.5); it thickens toward the foot.

band.label: Spectrum width
band.note: Width of the two prismatic ribbons in the fog, as a multiple of the page’s 64 px.

grain.label: Grain
grain.note: The film grain laid once over the plate, as a multiple of its own. 0 leaves the paint clean.

specks.label: Dust points
specks.note: How many dust points are scattered on the black, as a multiple of the page’s own.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every seeded choice the page makes: the grain, the noise and where each mark falls. 0 is the page’s own drawing.

techniques.implementation: Flowers and lights drawn in sharp line and then softened: blur, glow and bokeh over a flat ground. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
